description: This Java class provides utility functions to address memory leak issues in the OpenMRS application, specifically focusing on cancelling MySQL connection timers.

classes.name: MemoryLeakUtil
classes.description: Utility class containing methods to prevent memory leaks by cancelling internal MySQL connection timers.

methods.name: shutdownMysqlCancellationTimer
methods.description: Attempts to reflectively access and cancel the MySQL JDBC connection cancellation timer to prevent memory leaks.
